replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
I'm going to give my 100% honest opinion, don't hate me :c
  • It looks identical to the original map, basically it looks like you switched the dome at spawn and castle at middle from Quintus 1. 
  • It looks smaller than the original map. This limits gameplay. I'm guessing most of the deaths will be void deaths. >.<
  • I don't like the concept of the glass dome in the middle, it makes me feel like I'm playing inside a greenhouse. 
  • The monuments look identical to the original map. It's not unique. 
  • Only two monuments? ;o
I know the whole point of creating a sequel to the original map is to retain some of its old features, but, honestly, your map looks too similar to Quintus 1. 

It's a work in progress. If you work a little more at it, I bet it'll turn out great ;)
